flutterNotes.tokenStorage: Simpan token secara aman menggunakan flutter_secure_storage
flutterNotes.printer: Bluetooth Classic/SPP tidak dapat digunakan langsung oleh Web Bluetooth; gunakan native Android bridge atau plugin Bluetooth Classic
flutterNotes.accountDeletion: Clear local credentials after deleted:true. The app must reconcile its own offline queue before requesting deletion; the server cannot inspect browser/device queues.
flutterNotes.googleDeletion: Use a fresh Google OpenID Connect ID token with serverClientId equal to GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. This is not a Google access token or Firebase ID token.
flutterNotes.jsonResponses: All /api/* routes and /account/delete return JSON errors even when Accept is omitted; still send the documented headers.
